# music_theory

`music_theory.hpp` is the dependency-free pitch and transposition header from
mnxdom (https://github.com/rpatters1/mnxdom, commit
`45bf46221c00411e968c851ff9a1be4e202af5c2`), unchanged. It is MIT licensed
(the notice is at the top of the file). The engine's MNX model uses it in
`src/importexport/mnx/model/music.cpp`.
